601.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
601.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

601.clozeText: Oak Tree Secondary School is a modern school located in the town center. The school (23) ________ about eight hundred students and fifty teachers. In the classrooms, there (24) ________ modern projectors and whiteboards. Students study many interesting subjects such as English, Science, and (25) ________. During break time, students often play sports or chat with their classmates in the (26) ________ schoolyard. Everyone feels (27) ________ when learning here.
601.readingText: Mai is twelve years old and she is a student in grade 6 at Thang Long Lower Secondary School. She has long black hair and big round eyes. Mai is a helpful and creative girl. At school, she is good at Art and English. In her free time, she enjoys drawing pictures of animals and reading fairy tales. Her best friend is Linh, who lives next door. Every weekend, Mai and Linh ride their bicycles around the peaceful lake near their houses or help their mothers plant flowers in the garden.

Oak Tree Secondary School is a modern school located in the town center. The school (23) ________ about eight hundred students and fifty teachers. In the classrooms, there (24) ________ modern projectors and whiteboards. Students study many interesting subjects such as English, Science, and (25) ________. During break time, students often play sports or chat with their classmates in the (26) ________ schoolyard. Everyone feels (27) ________ when learning here.

📖 ĐOẠN VĂN ĐỌC HIỂU (READING COMPREHENSION - PART 5):
Mai is twelve years old and she is a student in grade 6 at Thang Long Lower Secondary School. She has long black hair and big round eyes. Mai is a helpful and creative girl. At school, she is good at Art and English. In her free time, she enjoys drawing pictures of animals and reading fairy tales. Her best friend is Linh, who lives next door. Every weekend, Mai and Linh ride their bicycles around the peaceful lake near their houses or help their mothers plant flowers in the garden.

602.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

603.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
603.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

604.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
604.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

605.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
605.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

606.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

607.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
607.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

608.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
608.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

609.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
609.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

Every weekend, Mai and Linh ride their bicycles around the peaceful lake near their houses or help their mothers plant flowers in the garden.

610.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
610.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

611.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
611.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

612.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
612.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

613.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
613.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

615.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
615.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

616.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
616.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

617.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
617.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

questions.text:
Write a paragraph (60-80 words) about your new school or your best friend. You can use these cues:
Cues: What is the name of your school/friend? What are the facilities or characteristics? What activities do you do together and what are your feelings?
questions.correct: I would like to tell you about my new school, Dong Yen Lower Secondary School. It is located in a quiet village with fresh air. The school has three modern buildings, twenty well-equipped classrooms, a large computer lab, and a green playground. My teachers are dedicated and enthusiastic, while my classmates are friendly and supportive. I always look forward to going to school every morning.
questions.explanation:
✍️ BÀI VIẾT MẪU THAM KHẢO ĐẠT ĐIỂM TỐI ĐA (1.0đ):
I would like to tell you about my new school, Dong Yen Lower Secondary School. It is located in a quiet village with fresh air. The school has three modern buildings, twenty well-equipped classrooms, a large computer lab, and a green playground. 619.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
619.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

620.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 6
620.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
An:: Hi Phong, how is your first week at your new secondary school?
Phong:: Hello An! It is exciting. The school has a big library and a large playground.
An:: What is your favourite subject?
Phong:: I like English and Science the most. The teachers are very friendly.
An:: Do you play sports after school with your new friends?
Phong:: Yes, we often play football or badminton in the schoolyard.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
My name is Mi and I live in a lovely town house with my parents and brother. Our house has six rooms: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. My favourite room is my bedroom because it has a big window looking over a green garden. In my bedroom, there is a comfortable bed, a study desk with a bookshelf, and a blue wardrobe. I always keep my room clean and tidy every day.

701.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
701.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

701.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
701.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

702.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

702.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
702.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

703.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
703.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

703.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
703.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

704.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
704.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

704.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
704.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

705.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
705.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

705.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
705.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

706.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

706.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

707.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
707.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

707.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
707.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

708.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
708.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

708.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
708.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

709.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
709.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

709.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. 710.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
710.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

710.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
710.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

711.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
711.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

711.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
711.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

712.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
712.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

712.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
712.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

Every afternoon, I spend thirty minutes weeding the flowerbeds, watering the tomatoes, and planting fresh herbs. Gardening helps me appreciate nature, reduces stress after school, and provides delicious organic vegetables for my family. It makes me feel joyful and relaxed.

713.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
713.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

713.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
713.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

714.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
714.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

714.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
714.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

715.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
715.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

715.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
715.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

716.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
716.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

716.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
716.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.

📖 ĐOẠN VĂN ĐỌC HIỂU (READING COMPREHENSION - PART 5):
Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. 717.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
717.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. 718.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
718.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

718.clozeText: Leading a healthy lifestyle is essential for teenagers' comprehensive physical and mental development. First of all, adolescents should maintain a balanced (23) ________ rich in vegetables, fresh fruits, and whole grains. They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Secondly, getting at least eight hours of sound (24) ________ each night allows the body and brain to rejuvenate properly. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
718.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

719.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
719.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

They should strictly limit their consumption of junk food, carbonated soft drinks, and deep-fried snacks. Regular physical exercise, such as cycling, swimming, or jogging, not only strengthens muscles (25) ________ also relieves mental stress. Finally, drinking sufficient clean water helps flush toxins out of the body and keeps the skin (26) ________. By establishing these beneficial habits early, teenagers can enjoy an energetic and (27) ________ youth.
719.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

720.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 7
720.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Lan:: Hi Mark, what do you usually do in your spare time?
Mark:: Hello Lan! I enjoy doing origami and planting flowers in the garden.
Lan:: Does gardening help you feel relaxed after studying?
Mark:: Yes, it keeps me close to nature and helps reduce study stress.
Lan:: Are you joining our school's Green Sunday club this weekend?
Mark:: Of course! We will clean the town park and collect plastic bottles for recycling.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Community service brings tremendous benefits to both volunteers and society. Last winter, our youth volunteer group organized a warm clothing donation program called Winter Warmth'. Over three hundred students donated thick jackets, warm wool blankets, and storybooks. We delivered these essential gifts directly to poor children living in remote highland villages in Ha Giang. Seeing their radiant smiles made all of us feel immense joy and happiness.

720.readingText: Community service is voluntary work conducted by individuals or groups to benefit their local community without expecting any financial reward. In many secondary schools across Viet Nam, students actively engage in diverse volunteer initiatives. Some students teach English or basic computer skills to underprivileged children in charity centers. Others participate in the Green Sundays' campaign by cleaning public streets, removing graffiti from walls, and planting shade trees along riverbanks. Furthermore, blood donation drives and free medical check-ups organized by youth unions offer invaluable support to elderly citizens. Participating in community service not only improves local living standards but also instills empathy, teamwork, and civic responsibility among young citizens.

801.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
801.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

801.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
801.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

802.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
802.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

802.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
802.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

803.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
803.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.
803.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
803.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

803.sampleWritingText: Life in the countryside holds a special charm for me because of its profound tranquility and wholesome environment. Firstly, the atmosphere is refreshingly pure and unpolluted, far removed from urban smog and perpetual traffic noise. Rolling green hills, expansive golden rice fields, and meandering rivers offer breathtaking scenery. Secondly, the villagers are remarkably warm-hearted, compassionate, and always ready to assist one another during harvest times. Living close to nature brings me inner serenity and revitalizes my mental well-being.
