804.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
804.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

804.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
804.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

805.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
805.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

805.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
805.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

806.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

806.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
806.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

806.sampleWritingText: Life in the countryside holds a special charm for me because of its profound tranquility and wholesome environment. Firstly, the atmosphere is refreshingly pure and unpolluted, far removed from urban smog and perpetual traffic noise. Rolling green hills, expansive golden rice fields, and meandering rivers offer breathtaking scenery. Secondly, the villagers are remarkably warm-hearted, compassionate, and always ready to assist one another during harvest times. Living close to nature brings me inner serenity and revitalizes my mental well-being.

807.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
807.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

807.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
807.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

808.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
808.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

808.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
808.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

809.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

809.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

810.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
810.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

810.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
810.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

811.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
811.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

811.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
811.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

812.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
812.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

812.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
812.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

813.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
813.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

813.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
813.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

814.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
814.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

814.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
814.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

815.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
815.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

815.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
815.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

816.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
816.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

816.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
816.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

817.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
817.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

817.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
817.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. 817.passageText:
📖 ĐOẠN VĂN ĐIỀN TỪ (CLOZE TEXT - PART 4):
Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.

📖 ĐOẠN VĂN ĐỌC HIỂU (READING COMPREHENSION - PART 5):
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

818.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
818.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

818.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
818.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

819.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
819.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. 819.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

820.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 8
820.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nam:: Hi Mai, what do you usually do to unwind after strenuous school hours?
Mai:: Hello Nam! I fancy making origami crafts and helping my mother cultivate vegetables in the garden.
Nam:: Do you participate in any school clubs?
Mai:: Yes, I am an active member of our school's IT and English Speaking Club.
Nam:: How does joining the club benefit your studies?
Mai:: It helps me improve my presentation skills and cope effectively with academic pressure.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Life in the Vietnamese countryside offers a harmonious rhythm that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of major metropolises. During the golden harvest season, the vast paddy fields stretch like boundless carpets of ripe rice under the radiant sunlight. Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.

Local farmers work diligently from early dawn, harvesting golden stalks and loading grain carts. In the evening, the peaceful village echoes with children's laughter as they fly paper kites on grassy dikes or cycle along winding riverbanks. The close-knit camaraderie among villagers creates a safe, caring, and tranquil living environment.
820.clozeText: Harvest time is the busiest yet most joyful season in the Vietnamese countryside. Early in the morning, farmers head out to the fields where ripe golden rice stretches as far as the eye can see. Many communes now use modern combine (23) ________ to cut and thresh rice much faster than in the past. After a hard working day, villagers gather in the communal yard to chat, drink green tea, and enjoy freshly made rice cakes. Children eagerly fly kites on river (24) ________ or play traditional games under the autumn breeze. Village life during harvest is full of laughter, warmth, and mutual (25) ________ among neighbors. For urban visitors, experiencing this simple rural atmosphere brings deep peace and helps them (26) ________ after busy workdays. The hospitality of countryside people always leaves an unforgettable (27) ________ on everyone.
820.readingText:
Spending leisure time effectively plays an essential role in the physical and mental well-being of secondary students. After demanding school hours, engaging in favorite hobbies allows teenagers to recharge their energy and develop creative talents.

Among various pastimes, DIY (Do-It-Yourself) crafts and handmade projects have become increasingly popular among teenagers. Many students enjoy folding origami, knitting wool scarves, or making personalized photo frames from recycled cardboard. Creating things by hand requires patience and focus, which helps young people train their concentration and express their artistic imagination. In addition, giving handmade gifts to family members and friends brings immense joy and strengthens personal bonds.

Besides indoor crafts, outdoor activities like cycling, playing badminton, and skateboarding offer fantastic health benefits. They keep teenagers active, improve physical fitness, and prevent them from spending excessive hours staring at smartphone screens. Finding a balanced combination of creative hobbies and sports is the key to a happy teenage life.

Firstly, the atmosphere is refreshingly pure and unpolluted, far removed from urban smog and perpetual traffic noise. Rolling green hills, expansive golden rice fields, and meandering rivers offer breathtaking scenery. 901.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

901.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
901.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

902.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

902.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
902.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

Write a paragraph (80-100 words) about a traditional craft village you know or effective strategies for 9th graders to cope with study stress. You can use these cues:

Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. 903.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

904.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 9
904.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

904.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
904.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

905.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 9
905.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

905.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
905.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

906.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
906.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

907.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 9
907.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

907.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
907.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

908.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 9
908.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

908.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
908.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

909.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.
