909.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
909.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

910.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 9
910.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

910.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
910.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

911.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 9
911.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

912.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 9
912.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

912.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
912.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

913.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

913.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
913.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

Write a paragraph (80-100 words) about a traditional craft village you know or effective strategies for 9th graders to cope with study stress. You can use these cues:

✍️ BÀI VIẾT MẪU THAM KHẢO ĐẠT ĐIỂM TỐI ĐA (1.0đ):
To effectively manage academic pressure during the crucial grade 9 examination period, students should adopt proactive coping strategies. Firstly, designing a realistic revision timetable allows adolescents to distribute their study tasks methodically without resorting to exhausting late-night cramming. Secondly, dedicating thirty minutes daily to physical exercise, such as brisk walking, swimming, or cycling, stimulates endorphin release and revitalizes mental stamina. Finally, sharing anxieties with empathetic parents and school counselors prevents emotional burnout. Balancing hard work with mindful relaxation guarantees academic success.

914.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

915.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 9
915.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

915.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
915.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

916.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 9
916.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

916.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
916.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

917.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

917.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
917.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

918.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ I - LỚP 9
918.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

918.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
918.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

919.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

919.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
919.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

920.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tom:: Hi Mai! Where did you go last weekend with your class?
Mai:: Hello Tom! We had a wonderful field trip to Bat Trang pottery village near Ha Noi.
Tom:: Bat Trang? That sounds exciting! Did you try making any pottery yourself?
Mai:: Yes! A local artisan guided us on how to mold wet clay on a spinning wheel to make a small bowl.
Tom:: Was it difficult to shape the clay?
Mai:: It required patience and steady hands, but it was so much fun. Crafting pottery helped me unwind and appreciate traditional handicrafts.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Da Nang is widely celebrated as one of the most livable, modern, and beautiful cities in Viet Nam. Situated along the scenic central coast, the city combines stunning natural landscapes such as the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula with modern public infrastructure. The local government maintains clean streets, efficient electric bus transit, and beautiful sandy beaches. Furthermore, iconic landmarks like the Dragon Bridge, which breathes fire and water on weekend evenings, make Da Nang an attractive destination for visitors.

920.clozeText: Many cities in Viet Nam are striving to become greener and more sustainable. Local authorities are expanding public parks, planting more trees along streets, and developing efficient bus (23) ________. Consequently, many citizens choose to travel by public transport or bicycle instead of riding motorbikes, which significantly reduces traffic (24) ________ and air pollution. In addition, urban communities encourage residents to sort domestic waste and reduce single-use plastic (25) ________. Modern green cities also feature pedestrian zones where families can walk, socialize, and enjoy street food safely. Creating pleasant green spaces not only improves public (26) ________ but also makes urban life more enjoyable and (27) ________.
920.readingText:
Bat Trang is an ancient pottery village located on the banks of the Red River, about thirteen kilometers from central Ha Noi. The village has a rich history dating back over five hundred years, renowned across the country for producing exquisite ceramics and porcelain items.

In Bat Trang, traditional pottery making is passed down from one generation to the next. Local artisans skillfully shape wet clay on spinning wheels to create various everyday items, including bowls, vases, tea sets, and decorative plates. After shaping, each ceramic piece is carefully hand-painted with traditional patterns like lotus flowers, dragons, or pastoral landscapes before being baked in high-temperature kilns.

Today, Bat Trang has become a popular tourist destination for domestic and international visitors. Tourists, especially young students, eagerly participate in pottery workshops where they can craft their own clay souvenirs under the guidance of skilled craftsmen. Preserving this centuries-old handicraft not only provides sustainable income for local families but also keeps Vietnamese cultural identity vibrant for future generations.

questions.text:
Write a paragraph (80-100 words) about a traditional craft village you know or effective strategies for 9th graders to cope with study stress. You can use these cues:
Cues: What craft village or stress management strategy are you focusing on? What are its unique features, causes, or practical steps? What are the positive outcomes and personal lessons?
questions.correct: To effectively manage academic pressure during the crucial grade 9 examination period, students should adopt proactive coping strategies. Firstly, designing a realistic revision timetable allows adolescents to distribute their study tasks methodically without resorting to exhausting late-night cramming. Secondly, dedicating thirty minutes daily to physical exercise, such as brisk walking, swimming, or cycling, stimulates endorphin release and revitalizes mental stamina. Finally, sharing anxieties with empathetic parents and school counselors prevents emotional burnout. Balancing hard work with mindful relaxation guarantees academic success.
questions.explanation:
✍️ BÀI VIẾT MẪU THAM KHẢO ĐẠT ĐIỂM TỐI ĐA (1.0đ):
To effectively manage academic pressure during the crucial grade 9 examination period, students should adopt proactive coping strategies. Firstly, designing a realistic revision timetable allows adolescents to distribute their study tasks methodically without resorting to exhausting late-night cramming. Secondly, dedicating thirty minutes daily to physical exercise, such as brisk walking, swimming, or cycling, stimulates endorphin release and revitalizes mental stamina. Finally, sharing anxieties with empathetic parents and school counselors prevents emotional burnout. Balancing hard work with mindful relaxation guarantees academic success.
